topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and annual security and IRC 7216 acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.8)
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk quarterly, including Practice Cloud risks
Practice Cloud CISO reports to the division president with a dotted line to the Group CISO; roles in POL-01
Background checks before access; annual and role-based training for support engineers (POL-05 4.4)
Accountability through POL-01 roles, risk acceptance authority, and sanctions
Asset and data inventories from cloud tooling; tenant and document-level audit logs

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies and the Practice Cloud supplement published and acknowledged every year
Service commitments in the customer agreement, security addendum, sub-processor list, and trust portal
control_owner: Practice Cloud trust and assurance director
evidence: Customer agreements; sub-processor list; trust portal
gap: AI document intake (launched 2026-02-02) and its model provider are not in the system description, the sub-processor list, or customer communications; the product page claimed "99% accurate extraction" without substantiation (P03 PC-G08, PC-G09, PC-G14, PC-G18)
remediation: Describe the feature and the model provider (subservice organization, carve-out) for the period ending 2026-09-30; sub-processor notice with objection right; withdraw or substantiate the accuracy claim (POAM-020)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and risk tolerance in POL-01 and the P01 method
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis with the Practice Cloud division register (18 risks)
Fraud and insider risks considered (support staff misuse, payment link tampering)
Significant changes (new features, new sub-processors, new regions) assessed for risk before release
evidence: Risk register change log; release records
gap: The AI feature launch was not assessed as a significant change for privacy, IRC 7216, or contract effects
remediation: AI and sub-processor gate in the release process (POL-01 4.9, 4.13; POAM-020)

control_description: Group internal audit assesses common controls yearly and samples Practice Cloud controls; annual SOC 2 examination by an unaffiliated CPA firm
Deficiencies tracked in the group POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 baseline and the common control catalog
evidence: Practice Cloud SSP; common control catalog

control_description: General IT controls through SYS-G1 to SYS-G3 and the Practice Cloud release pipeline

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies and the Practice Cloud supplement (v2025)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Single sign-on, MFA, PAM for staff; tenant isolation with row-level security; encryption with group-managed keys
evidence: Identity and key configuration; P07 AC-3 (cross-tenant tests passed)

control_description: Identity governance from HR events; data owner approval for production access
Quarterly certification; just-in-time privileged access; ticket-linked, time-limited support access to customer tenants
Physical security inherited from cloud provider B (carved out)
Provider media sanitization; logical deletion procedures

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Hub firewalls, web application firewall, and DDoS protection

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all transmission; customer document exchange only through the portal

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR and workload protection; curated open-source packages

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Continuous vulnerability scanning; annual penetration test; guardrail drift reports

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 group SOC monitoring; Practice Cloud on-call reviews product alerts
gap: Bulk-download and support-access alerts stay in the Practice Cloud console and are not in the group SIEM (P07 SI-04c.01; SW-011)
remediation: Forward the alerts to the SIEM (POAM-004)

control_description: Triage and severity rating by the SOC; Practice Cloud on-call escalates to the SOC
Group incident response plan, P08 runbook, and the customer notice register
control_owner: Practice Cloud trust and assurance director
gap: The 140 customers with 24-hour notice terms are not flagged in the incident tooling, and Practice Cloud scopes incidents outside the group severity scale (P03 PC-G15; P07 IR-04d.[03])
remediation: Flag 24-hour customers in the tooling; adopt the group severity scale and the combined matrix (POAM-005)

control_description: Recovery from immutable backups and the warm standby region; lessons learned
Pull requests, peer review, automated tests, and change board approval
gap: AI feature approved without privacy, IRC 7216, and contract impact analysis; no prompt-injection or adversarial document testing (P07 CM-03b.[02], CM-04[02], SA-11b.)
remediation: Release gate (POAM-020); red-team testing added to the release test suite (POAM-021)

control_description: Continuity plans and cyber insurance; warm standby region

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Tiered vendor program; assurance reports reviewed for cloud provider B and tier 1 sub-processors
gap: The AI document intake model provider was not assessed before use and is not monitored (P07 SA-09a.[02], SA-09c.; P03 PC-G11)
remediation: Model provider assurance review and annual monitoring; contract term for U.S.-only processing (POAM-020)

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling; filing-season load tests every December
Multi-zone deployment; database replicas; warm standby region; immutable backups in the group vault
Annual failover test to the warm standby region; quarterly restore tests
evidence: DR test report (2026-05); restore test records

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Customer data classified Restricted (POL-04 4.1); retention per customer agreement
control_owner: Practice Cloud trust and assurance director
gap: The model provider's U.S.-only processing and 30-day deletion are configuration settings, not contract terms (P03 PC-G06)
remediation: Contract amendment with the model provider (POAM-020)

control_description: Customer data deleted within 60 days after contract end with a certificate
control_owner: Practice Cloud trust and assurance director
gap: Deletion is manual; 11 of 40 sampled terminations had certificates after day 60 (P03 PC-G13)
